messages:
Priya: kicking off a very small, targeted private-preview 'pocket pilot' to validate onboarding + ops for Redwood Private. aim: 4–6 security-conscious customers, 6 week engagement.
Sam: timeline?
Priya: target kickoff week of Oct 4. 6 weeks active + 2 week follow-up.
Diego: propose acceptance criteria early: onboarding docs >90% clarity score in initial survey, infra reproducibility (we can reproduce perf on 2/4 setups), and no more than 1 production incident that blocks usage.
Marta: legal note — we need a short DP NDA + a limited-data-processing addendum. i'll draft and share.
Nikhil: ops asks: dedicated support channel, 2-hr/week engineer office hours, and an incident runbook for the pilot. can commit rotation if scope limited.
Priya: feedback cadence suggestion: weekly async notes + one 60–90m working session every other week (technical deep dives). capture prompt sets and evals in a shared repo.
Sam: compensation: credits + $1.5k honorarium per org? keeps it simple. thoughts?
Diego: agreed on credits + honorarium. also offer a short post-pilot case study credit if they consent.
Priya: recruitment screen: must have a security or compliance requirement that would push them toward Private/Dedicated, willingness to run small test dataset, and product contact for weekly sync. I'll draft screener.
Marta: I'll push NDA + a quick legal checklist for customers (what logs we need, anonymization expectations).
Nikhil: metrics we should instrument: cold start tail latency, p50/p95/p99 token latency, successful request ratio, cost per 1k tokens, and KV cache hit rate. Diego — can you own eval harness?
Diego: will own eval harness + run the regression checks. need example prompt bank from product.
Priya: rollout plan: canary to 1 customer for 1 week, then expand to 2–3, then full pilot. fallback: route to hosted model variant if Private runtime degraded.
Sam: I'll coordinate invites & recruitment emails. can someone pair on the invite copy?
Priya: i'll write initial copy and post in this thread for review.
scott-bot: poll created (best kickoff time): Morning / Afternoon / Flexible — vote!
Nikhil: ops question — what SLA do we promise during pilot? suggest: best-effort response within 4 hours for P1, engineered on-call can commit 2 hrs/week.
Priya: agreed — list SLA in invite as "pilot support" not a formal SLA.
Priya: quick TL;DR checklist (owners): 1) Screener & invite (Priya), 2) NDA + legal checklist (Marta), 3) Ops rotation + runbook (Nikhil), 4) Eval harness & prompt bank (Diego), 5) Recruitment emails + scheduling (Sam). respond with :thumbsup: if good.
Sam: :thumbsup:
Diego: :thumbsup:
Marta: :thumbsup:
Nikhil: :thumbsup:
Priya: thanks — i'll post the invite draft here by EOD tomorrow and tag owners for edits.
Sam: will sync legal early tomorrow.
Priya: end of thread — moving to action items.
